Public safety center

Verify the company before freight changes hands

Use official records, confirm insurance directly, and keep the pickup details inside the platform. A paid subscription does not replace independent verification.

1

Look up USDOT / MC

Open the official FMCSA SAFER Company Snapshot and match the legal name, address, authority, and phone.

2

Check licensing & insurance

Review the federal licensing and insurance record. Contact the insurer independently when anything looks inconsistent.

3

Follow the insurance checklist

Check insured name, policy dates, cargo limits, exclusions, and certificate contact details before pickup.

4

Watch for fraud signals

Slow down for changed payment instructions, mismatched contacts, off-platform pressure, or authority details that do not line up.

Shipper pickup checklist

Before the truck arrives

  1. Confirm commodity, dimensions, weight, value, and special handling.
  2. Set a specific pickup window and a named site contact.
  3. Confirm dock, forklift, liftgate, ramp, pallet jack, and driver-assist needs.
  4. Match the truck, plate, driver identity, carrier name, USDOT/MC, and insurance.
  5. Photograph freight condition and count before loading.
  6. Keep rate confirmation, messages, bill of lading, pickup proof, and delivery proof together.
Driver pain → product checks

We turn trucking headaches into load checks.

The goal is not just more posts. It is fewer bad-fit, low-trust, unclear, stale loads wasting a driver’s day.

Ghost / duplicate loads

Require expiration, last-confirmed time, and duplicate detection.

Vague details

Ask for weight, dimensions, dock, forklift, liftgate/ramp, driver assist, commodity, and photos.

Wrong equipment category

Match exact equipment instead of throwing every driver into the same generic load bucket.

No response

Track response behavior and let drivers rate communication after jobs.

Payment / double-brokering risk

Use payment grade, identity checks, customer ratings, and off-platform-pressure flags.

Rates below target

Let drivers save lane targets and warn when a load is below their minimum.

Carrier verification center

Verify a carrier before booking.

Search by name, company, USDOT, or MC number; review the carrier card; then save the check to the load.

Core verification

Verify the carrier before booking.

No booking until DOT/MC lookup, ID check, insurance upload, customer/broker verification, and manual admin approval are complete.

1

DOT/MC lookup

Check authority, business name, operating status, and dispatch identity before a load is bookable.

2

ID check

Match the driver or broker photo ID to the account, phone, and company contact before approval.

3

Insurance upload

Collect cargo/liability certificates, expiration dates, coverage amounts, and file uploads.

4

Customer / broker verification

Score payment history, disputes, quick-pay availability, and scam risk before the lane opens.

5

Manual admin approval

An admin signs off last. No booking until the review is marked approved.

6

Scam prevention

Flag stolen authority patterns, suspicious payment behavior, off-platform pressure, fake contacts, and repeated disputes.

Broker + payment trust

Make payment risk visible before a driver accepts the load.

Drivers need to know if the broker is real, insured, responsive, and likely to pay on time.

Reputation dashboard

Track score, progress, badges, and disputes.

Five-star feedback is only one input inside the American Truckers Trust Score. Verified loads, safety, professionalism, and long-term performance matter more.

Finish a verified load before leaving shipper/facility feedback.
Scam / risk flags
Structured answers are required first. Comments with threats, discrimination, private information, profanity aimed at a person, or unrelated personal attacks are blocked.

American Truckers Trust Score

0–1000 ranking across reliability, professionalism, freight safety, experience, and verified partner feedback. One load can start a record, but not dominate the board.

Last 90 days vs lifetime

Scam minimizers

  • Verified identity before posting
  • Verified payment method before booking
  • No hidden customer contact until matched
  • Risk flags trigger admin review
  • Repeat complaints reduce visibility or suspend account

Pricing

Pricing by role and truck count

Posting-only access for shippers, plus load-finding access for verified drivers, brokers, and fleets.

Customer Pickup Request

$9.99/mo

For customers who need loads picked up from their office, warehouse, shop, or place of work.

  • Direct load request intake
  • Ralph, the AI intake helper, cleans up request details
  • Verified brokers/carriers can view requests
  • Post loads and pickup requests — cannot claim other people's loads

Independent Driver

$29.99/mo

For self-insured drivers and owner-operators working for themselves.

  • Post loads
  • Browse and claim matching loads
  • Saved equipment and lanes
  • Matching load alerts after carrier verification

Carrier & Broker 1–3 Trucks

$59.99/mo

For brokers or small operators covering early direct load requests.

  • View verified customer requests
  • Respond to matching demand
  • Basic truck capacity profile
  • Claim loads and post covered freight

Carrier & Carrier & Broker 4–7 Trucks

$79.99/mo

For growing carriers, fleets, and brokers with more truck coverage.

  • More truck profiles
  • Coverage for 4–7 trucks
  • Saved customer lanes
  • Claim loads and post covered freight

Carrier & Broker 8–12 Trucks

$149.99/mo

For higher-capacity teams that can cover more lanes and equipment types.

  • Coverage for 8–12 trucks
  • Priority placement for posted loads
  • Saved customer lanes
  • Claim loads and post covered freight

Dispatcher & Broker

$189.99/mo

For dispatchers and brokers coordinating freight, carrier coverage, and customer communication.

  • Find, request, and post loads
  • Dispatch and broker workspace access
  • Saved lanes and alerts
  • Company activity history

FAQ

Quick answers before you sign up

Short answers, no fluff — the same way a good broker desk would want it.

Is this a load board?

It’s a freight and request marketplace with lane alerts, trust checks, and role-based access.

Can I sign in without paying again?

Yes. Paid users can return with the same email and password. The site should not send them back to checkout.

What gets verified?

DOT/MC, ID, insurance, broker/customer payment trust, and manual admin approval before booking.

How do lane alerts work?

Save equipment, pickup area, and rate target. Matched verified loads show up when they fit.
